objective: maximize HP when first stepping from MT1 into MT2, with no other-floor detours
scope: ONLY remake MT1 from post-MT0 initial stats/keys; not Flash and not full tower

metrics.rssDefinition: process lifetime peak RSS, includes JSON load; isolated CLI process recommended

assumptions: No MT0 return, no MT2 detour, no shops, no clock or RNG.
Floor scripts/hooks empty; all present enemies special=0; mdef=0.
Starting stair can be left at initial arrival but cannot be re-entered; touching upper stair ends experiment.
Book pickup has no stat effect. Walking within a cleared component is free for this HP objective.
proofArgument: Every meaningful action removes exactly one item/enemy/door. Flood fill enumerates every reachable frontier action. Identical consumed mask fixes stats/keys/rewards. Within the same free component, a higher-HP label dominates because all supported battle costs are HP-independent. Exhausting this finite quotient establishes the stated local optimum, conditional on the declared transition model.
